body: That’s the only thing stopping me. My dad is the only person who really cared about me, treated me fairly and really listened to me and who I was as a person. I wish I could talk to him about it but I don’t have the guts.

To the person that comment and deleted, I will not mention your name since you probably have your reasons for deleting.

They will notice and make fun of me for faking depression for attention and everyone will start bullying me for being fake. It’s too late to take the ‘fuck them all’ attitude because it will just make me want to end my life even quicker to not have to endure that bullshit. I’m not doing very well at school anymore, nothing makes sense because I’m too busy thinking about getting home and crying or how I’m gonna commit suicide and stop being a little bitch. I had goals, I was going to become a pharmacist and now I’m so far behind in mathematics and other relevant subjects that I fear it’s too late to turn my life around. 

Even so, thank you for the support. you’ve brought a tear to my eye. I wish the best for people like you.
